title: Data-driven Experimental Modal Analysis by Dynamic Mode Decomposition
summary: This paper discusses the application of Dynamic Mode Decomposition (DMD) to the extraction of modal properties of linear mechanical systems, i.e., experimental modal analysis (EMA). First, theoretical background of the DMD is briefly reviewed and its relevance to the Ibrahim time-domain method is discussed. Second, DMD is applied to a single DOF system and multi-DOF discrete system to discuss the applicability and interpretation of the DMD as a method of EMA.
